principles: Each category is a term people search for and that frontier-lab model cards or benchmark companies use as a section heading.
Each category has anchor benchmarks that frontier labs report or well-known benchmark companies publish.
Two categories whose top-10 benchmarks overlap by 50% or more are reviewed for a merge; 70% or more merges by default.
A benchmark has one primary category and at most two secondary categories. Trends counts use primary plus secondary.
Vague umbrellas (Vision-Language Models, Data Analysis, Coding, Content Generation) are not categories.
